I'm a student of the Master's in Statistical Sciences at Università di Bologna (🇮🇹 Italy), currently on an exchange semester abroad at Monash University (🇦🇺 Australia) .

My study topics include multidimensional data analysis, statistical modeling and neural networks. I have personal interest in all kinds of data that relate to geography, maps and transportation infrastructure (motorways, train networks, plane routes).

In the past, I've contributed substantially to the [OpenStreetMap project](https://osm.org) with edits around my hometown of Bologna, and the broader Emilia-Romagna region.

I've been a poll worker for 5 different instances of electoral consultations in Italy, both at ordinary polling stations and postal voting counting stations. I've covered most existing roles, from scrutineer to president.

I've played basketball agonistically, chess and played the piano for 10 years. In my free time, I also like to ride my bike or do hikes.
